</noinclude><includeonly><div class="infobox" style="width: 22em; float: right">
<div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold">{{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}}</div>
{| class="infobox-table" style="width: 100%"
|-
! scope="row" | Type
| {{{type|unknown}}}
|-
! scope="row" | Inventor
| {{#if: {{{inventor|}}} | [[{{{inventor}}}]] | — }}
|-
! scope="row" | Website
| {{#if: {{{url|}}} | [{{{url}}} official site] | }}
|}
</div></includeonly><noinclude>

== Usage ==

Copy this into an article:

<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Infobox widget
| name     = Doohickey
| type     = Gadget
| inventor = Ada Lovelace
| url      = https://example.com
}}
</syntaxhighlight>

The parameters are documented for [[Wikipedia:VisualEditor|VisualEditor]] in
the block below.

<templatedata>
{
    "description": "An infobox for widgets.",
    "format": "block",
    "params": {
        "name": {
            "label": "Name",
            "description": "Name of the widget",
            "type": "string",
            "suggested": true
        },
        "type": {
            "label": "Type",
            "type": "string"
        },
        "inventor": {
            "label": "Inventor",
            "type": "wiki-page-name"
        },
        "url": {
            "label": "Website",
            "type": "url"
        }
    }
}
</templatedata>
